routeName: Q10 Open Air Market - Terminal Bas Serian
sourceTitle: Kadar Tambang Q10 (Serian): May 2025 full between-stop matrix + Sept 2025 current linear table
notes: Two independent LPKP documents for this route: the full stop-to-stop matrix from the 14 May 2025 poster and the current linear terminal rows from the Sept 2025 route poster. They agree on every comparable pair (11/11 outbound, 6/7 inbound) once the 11 Mar 2025 fare reduction is accounted for - both documents already sit below the pre-reduction fares quoted in the 10 Mar 2025 press statement (Open Air Market-PJS RM2.30, -Unimas Hospital RM2.70, -Siburan RM4.00). The matrix is therefore trusted for the pairs the linear rows do not cover; where the two disagree the later Sept 2025 value wins. Poster stops BS WISMA SEBERKAS (OPPOSITE) and BS UNIMAS have no match in the current GTFS outbound pattern and are excluded from priced pairs (48 poster stops vs 47 GTFS).
